- An open ocean with over 20 islands to explore.

- Customize your own island with buildings, crops, and farm animals.

- Over 25 characters to meet and befriend.

- More than 300 quests to make Mara a better place.

- Day and night cycle that has an effect on the world with climatic events.

notes.title: Summer in Mara supporting the WDC World Oceans Day Charity Sale
notes.content:
[b]As you might guessed, we love the sea. So today we are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Oceans Day!   [/b]

The WDC World Oceans Day Sale starts on 8th June and runs until 13th June, 10am PDT 2022, and you can save a fin-tastic 78% off our Chibig's Universe bundle. We will also donate 15% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.* 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23898/Chibig_Universe/

For those you are wondering what is the WDC, it's the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. WDC defends these remarkable creatures against the many threats they face by fighting to stop whaling, end captivity, prevent accidental entanglement and deaths in nets and create healthy seas. They also advocate for the vital role that whales and dolphins play in fighting climate change and keeping our planet healthy. Their vision is a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/f46b591b51b1e140c57d748db265013339b7188d.gif[/img]

If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: [url=https://uk.whales.org/]https://uk.whales.org/[/url]

You can find many other amazing games in the sale here: [url=https://bit.ly/OceansDaySteamSale]https://bit.ly/OceansDaySteamSale[/url]

Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! 

*15% of our net developer revenue from this sale will support Whale and Dolphin Conservation. Whale and Dolphin Conservation is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705)

notes.title: Summer in Mara Physical Collector's Edition on its way!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We’re back another day with exciting news. We started Chibig with an idea in our minds: to create a colorful and relaxing universe that the player would fall in love with. After Deiland: Pocket Planet, Summer in Mara, and now Ankora: Lost Days, we’re getting there, step by step.

Now, we’re happy to announce that our universe is getting bigger thanks to Tesura Games, a Spanish physical publisher that will help us to carry our worlds to your hands. We had signed a partnership with them to take our games to the physical world and now it’s time for Summer in Mara.

Thanks to Tesura, Summer in Mara will be released in physical, both in standard and Collector’s Edition, for Nintendo Switch and Playstation 4 (but you can play it on your Playstation 5).

And this is everything it includes:
[list]
[*] Game
[*] Collector's Box
[*] Artbook
[*] Napopo pin
[*] Diorama
[*] Double-Sided Poster
[*] Stickers
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/61c802b64b901845884dc15df3b7807015bcfb9d.png[/img]

Although it isn't a final date confirmed for this physical edition yet, we are pretty confident it will be available before the end of this year. So stay tuned and see you in Mara!

notes.title: Ankora, our new cute-as-heck exploration adventure, is now live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hi there!

How’s everything? I hope you’re great.

Today we are glad to introduce to you Ankora: Lost Days, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chibig/ankora-lost-days-a-cute-as-heck-exploration-adventure?ref=1sghmb]our new project on Kickstarter[/url]. Maybe you already know Mûn, from the shores of Mara but you have never seen Mûn like this before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/ddc21ffeb4369090856d7d21e2006aa45637e6db.png[/img]

Meet Mûn as a Junior Ranger from the Interstellar Patrol, stranded in Ankora, an unknown planet after her spaceship crashes there. Ankora: Lost Days happens before the events in Deiland: Pocket Planet and Summer in Mara. 

Ankora: Lost Days mixes terraforming, crafting, and exploring mechanics in a wild planet with a colorful style. Mûn must learn to overcome obstacles: rivers, lakes and waterfalls, mountains, level jumps... And many monsters. She will soon learn to make her own paths because Ankora is a unique and changing planet.

For this new campaign, we are happy to announce the partnership with Tesura Games to make a physical edition for Nintendo Switch and Playstation 4 that also includes Deiland: Pocket Planet, and a lot of goodies for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/a9d81af189e4e485e6327b361be43375b69abb47.jpg[/img]

Also, for the first 48 hours, we have a special [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chibig/ankora-lost-days-a-cute-as-heck-exploration-adventure?ref=1sghmb]Early Reward[/url] with a free digital copy of the Ankora Artbook. So hurry up before the time ends!

See you in Ankora!

notes.title: UPDATE: Fast travel and additional crafting points
notes.content:
Dear players,

A week ago we released Summer in Mara. During this week, you give us your feedback regarding different issues and ideas for us to work on and improve. 

We heard you and we want to use your feedback to improve Summer in Mara. In this update we implemented two features that will improve the experience of the game:

[list]
[*]  [b]Fast travel[/b]: Now Koa can travel immediately to any island that you have discovered previously. This way, you don't have to go from quadrant to quadrant, avoiding loading screens.

[*] [b] Crafting and cooking[/b]. We thought it's a good idea to let Koa craft and cook in other islands, near to the main characters. Now you can craft/cook in Taka's restaurant, Akaji forge and Dunna's island.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/d2db6b5959f554769fb0f0db27e6d6a7095f8500.png[/img]

We hope these improvements help you during the game. Please, keep sharing your feedback and feel free to give us your opinion.

See you in Mara,
Chibig.

notes.title: Story Trailer for the Summer in Mara adventure
notes.content:
On the planet Qü, Mara is the ocean that brings life to our islands and our lives. You’re Koa, a little adventurer who has to take care of her home island. She has never seen the outside world beyond this island, but the ocean has always called her. 

[previewyoutube=aYeuJ_jacFQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Koa has always lived with her grandma, Yaya Haku, a very strict old qüido. Yaya Haku allows Koa to go wherever she wants on the island. But there is a big door on a cliff and Koa can't touch or do anything to it. Surrounded in mystery, this door keeps a secret that only Yaya Haku knows about.

Now, Mara ocean is in danger. An evil corporation from another planet has arrived at planet Qü, attracted by a strange energy that emerges from the sea. They're the Elit and they want to conquer and exploit Mara's resources. 

With a visual novel style, you will meet and talk with over 20 characters. Getting to know about their life, problems, dreams, and worries is an important part of this adventure. You're not alone in the world. And the world doesn't end with you

notes.title: Qälis - The main island in Mara
notes.content:
We want to show you a little bit more about the main island in the game. Qälis is a small town with different qüidos, humans, cat-children and maybe even an elit or two. In this city, you can see the mixture of cultures scattered all through Mara. Old exotic qüido structures and symbols combine with more new and modern buildings. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/ab2c8474fd99fffa70173bbb612a58ccf4b5ddb1.png[/img]

A view of Qälis from your boat. This is the main island in the game, where you will meet people, trade with them and discover lots of secrets from Mara.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/cf773e2bf273e44cf3432d76b60e992f18df3647.png[/img]

The market in the island. Three twins run this place, but be careful with them, since they can be really tricky.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/64aa0d53d6c691bf2d4735aa417c27610582ca1b.png[/img]

In Qälis Temple you can meet Blu, a strange individual that doesn't talk much. But when Blu talks... Nobody knows what he meants. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/89f6ec3f85f81c8a1a63ee1b429959f3c151c432.png[/img]

Taka's Restaurant is famous in all Mara. He's a great chef, but very traditionalist. Brram, his nephew, wants to be like his uncle... But also wants to explore the galaxy. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/5759e5dc0456cb593a7ce9548709301b4b1e15d1.png[/img]

Akaji is the blacksmith in Qälis. In her forge, you can see her latest work. Like, well, can you see what emerge from the ground? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/258701ee0c97ac5b27118566a7dda8e51c25c770.png[/img]

Onzo is a cat-child, but also the adventurer like you! He kepts all kind of stories in his diary!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/b493f946c3775cc84a6ad94dcdc600db5d26c930.png[/img]

Awan's Tabern is a great place to enjoy a different meal. But a lot of qüidos don't like this kind of cuisine. 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/1e4620b09aba7f9bff4fb704665ef2b0579ea661.png[/img]
